name: planora
description: Planora is a private, adaptive life-planning, wellbeing, calendar, and AI companion.

scripts.dev: npm.cmd --workspace @planora/shared run build && concurrently -n api,web -c orange,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm.cmd --workspace @planora/shared run build && npm.cmd --workspace @planora/api run build && npm.cmd --workspace @planora/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm.cmd --workspace @planora/shared run build && npm.cmd --workspace @planora/api run typecheck && npm.cmd --workspace @planora/web run typecheck && npm.cmd --workspace @planora/mobile run typecheck
